battle.name: 第三次馬拉塔戰爭
battle.brief: 一八一七年初，浦那佩什瓦巴吉拉奧二世重整兵馬，聯同那伽浦爾邦斯勒、霍爾卡爾再起；十一月五日卡德基一役，英軍線列齊射與騎兵衝鋒破敵，十二月取浦那，翌年四月克阿西爾伽爾德堡，馬拉塔聯盟遂解。卡面長槍代表的方陣傳統已讓位給刺刀，但矛兵護住後排火槍手的作用，仍在浦那城外的進攻序列留痕。

kit.name: 長槍
kit.history: 方陣的長矛讓火槍隊站在後面。密西西比之後，長矛和火槍一起站住了。

countries: 英國東印度公司一方，總督法蘭西斯·勞登-黑斯廷斯坐鎮德里，孟買總督府承辦軍需與外交，最前線分兩支樞紐：德干軍由中將湯瑪斯·希斯洛普指揮，大王軍由總督本人率領，據稱集結兵力約十二萬人，下轄六十餘個本地步兵營、數十個英籍步兵營、大批騎兵與龍騎兵團、火砲、騎砲兵同火箭旅。浦那一線另設常駐代表芒特斯圖亞特·埃爾芬斯通，負責情報與談判。馬拉塔一方以浦那佩什瓦巴吉拉奧二世為首：那伽浦爾的穆德霍吉·邦斯勒（阿帕薩希布）於一八一六年五月與英方訂約後仍公開支持佩什瓦，印多爾霍爾卡爾亦出兵相助，瓜廖爾的辛地亞則在開戰之前退出戰鬥。依附兩家的平達里傭兵騎隊，首領奇特汗、卡里姆汗、瓦西爾·穆罕默德合計約三萬三千人，多數只持長矛；阿富汗裔的阿米爾汗在通克擁有一萬二千騎、一萬步兵與二百門火砲。依各方估算，馬拉塔聯盟總兵力約八萬一千步兵、十六萬六千騎兵與五百八十九門火砲，其中佩什瓦本人有步兵一萬四千、騎兵二萬八千、火砲三十七門，駐地浦那；霍爾卡爾駐印多爾，邦斯勒駐那伽浦爾。
countriesEn: On the British East India Company side, Governor-General Francis Rawdon-Hastings sat at Delhi while the Bombay Council handled supply and diplomacy, and the front was divided into two pivots: the Army of the Deccan under Lieutenant-General Thomas Hislop, and the Grand Army led by the Governor-General in person. The force assembled was said to number roughly 120,000 men, including more than sixty battalions of native infantry, several dozen British infantry battalions, large bodies of cavalry and dragoons, artillery, horse artillery and rocket troops. A separate Resident at Poona, Mountstuart Elphinstone, was responsible for intelligence and negotiation. On the Maratha side stood the Peshwa Baji Rao II at the head: Mudhoji Bhonsle of Nagpur, known as Appa Saheb, had signed a treaty with the British in May 1816 and yet still declared openly for the Peshwa, and Holkar of Indore also moved troops to help, while Scindia of Gwalior withdrew from the fight before hostilities began. The Pindari mercenary bands attached to the two houses were led by Chitu Khan, Karim Khan and Wasil Mohammad, together some 33,000 strong, most of them armed with nothing but spears; the Afghan Amir Khan held 12,000 horse, 10,000 foot and 200 guns at Tonk. By the estimates of the parties themselves the Maratha confederacy fielded about 81,000 infantry, 166,000 horse and 589 guns, of which the Peshwa himself had 14,000 foot, 28,000 horse and 37 guns, with his headquarters at Poona; Holkar sat at Indore and Bhonsle at Nagpur.
people: 佩什瓦巴吉拉奧二世（一七七五至一八一八年）是這場戰爭的起點人物。他於一八一六年在英方扶植下重返浦那王位，表面接受英方裁軍與不得與外國往來的約束，實際上以阿帕吉與拉馬吉兩位重臣為內應，命巴普·戈卡勒招募比爾與拉莫西部族傭兵，營造辛哈加德、拉伊加德、普蘭達爾等要塞，又於十月二十日達瑟拉節慶典上以假衝鋒向英軍示威，甚至企圖對駐在代表埃爾芬斯通下手。其總理津巴克吉·登格萊被指為刺殺英方使者甘加達爾·沙斯特里之嫌疑人，一八一七年六月《浦那條約》之後，佩什瓦索性撕破面皮。英方主事者為總督黑斯廷斯與德干軍主將希斯洛普；駐在代表埃爾芬斯通靠巴拉吉·潘特·納圖與賈斯旺特·拉奧·戈爾帕德通風報信，識破暗殺計劃；約翰·馬爾科姆參與追捕佩什瓦與平定平達里；普里茲勒與史密斯率軍在德干內陸追擊，一八一八年二月十九日阿斯蒂之戰中巴普·戈卡勒陣亡、薩塔拉王被俘。那伽浦爾方面，邦斯勒在英方駐在代表詹金斯要求裁軍時拒絕服從，待英軍拉漢、多維頓等部陸續抵達，終於兵敗西塔布爾迪，於一八一八年一月九日簽約。印多爾方面，幼主馬拉爾拉奧三世在生母圖爾西·拜被自己人處決後繼位，其軍隊隨後在馬希德普爾潰散，幕僚出面向英方求和。
peopleEn: The Peshwa Baji Rao II (1775-1818) was the point of departure for the whole war. Restored to the throne of Poona under British sponsorship in 1816, he outwardly accepted the British conditions - disbanding troops, no communication with foreign powers - while in fact using two of his leading ministers, Appaji and Ramaji, as his agents inside the arrangement, ordering Bapu Gokhale to hire Bhil and Ramoshi mercenary bands, fortifying Sinhagad, Raigad and Purandar, and making a sham charge at the British sepoys during the Dassera festival of 19 October as a show of force, with even a plan afoot against the Resident Elphinstone. His minister Trimbak Dengle was suspected of the murder of the British envoy Gangadhar Shastri, and after the Treaty of Poona of June 1817 the Peshwa dropped all pretence. On the British side the driving figures were Governor-General Hastings and General Hislop, commander of the Deccan army; the Resident Elphinstone was kept informed by Balaji Pant Natu and Jaswant Rao Ghorpade, and so saw through the assassination scheme; John Malcolm took part in the pursuit of the Peshwa and the breaking of the Pindaris; and Pritzler and Smith chased the Peshwa across the interior of the Deccan, until at Ashti on 19 February 1818 Bapu Gokhale fell defending his master and the Raja of Satara was taken prisoner. At Nagpur, Bhonsle refused the Resident Jenkins's demand that he disband his troops, and after the British reinforcements under Rahan and Doveton arrived he was beaten at Sitabuldi and signed a treaty on 9 January 1818. At Indore, the boy-king Malhar Rao Holkar III succeeded his mother Tulsi Bai after her own troops executed her, his army was destroyed at Mahidpur, and his ministers sued for peace.
kits: 卡面的長槍是十六至十七世紀西班牙大方陣（tercio）的標準長矛：四至五公尺長的硬木桿，前端裝鐵矛頭與護手，用來在方陣前排頂住敵騎、逼退跳過刺刀的襲擊，同時遮蔽後排裝填彈藥的火槍手。到一八一七年，歐洲各國陸軍早已全面改用帶刺刀的滑膛槍，長槍本身在歐洲戰場退場已逾百年；卡面仍保留它，正因這件兵器的功能在這場戰爭的兩端都還有對應物。馬拉塔一方，平達里騎兵多數只持長矛，馬拉塔步兵中亦有以矛為主的步兵與標槍手；火器是火繩槍為主、燧發滑膛槍為輔的混裝，火砲數量極大，全聯盟估算達五百八十九門，有象乘砲與馱馬拖曳的野砲，但技術與操作多由外籍軍官掌握，例如意大利人安東尼·波爾曼整編的佩什瓦砲隊，以及易卜拉欣·汗·加爾迪指揮的炮兵營。英方則是印度式燧發滑膛槍配刺刀、六磅與九磅野砲、騎砲兵、康格里夫火箭旅，並備有圍城重砲，用於攻取西塔布爾迪、塔爾納、馬萊岡與阿西爾伽爾德等堡壘。運輸與補給依靠象、駱駝、牛車與馬匹；英方補給線由浦那經孟買接上阿格拉與加爾各答方向，沿途糧草充足，進軍中曾發現中部印度穀物與飼料極為豐饒；馬拉塔方面的步兵多為比爾、拉莫西與阿拉伯傭兵，彈藥自備但形制雜亂，砲車與彈藥的調度遠不及英方有條理。
kitsEn: The pike on the card is the standard long spear of the sixteenth- and seventeenth-century Spanish tercio: a hardwood shaft four to five metres long, with an iron head and guard, used in the front rank of the square to hold off cavalry, to beat back attacks that vaulted the bayonets, and to shelter the musketeers behind as they reloaded. By 1817 every European army had long since gone over to the bayoneted smoothbore, and the pike itself had been absent from European battlefields for more than a century; it is kept on the card precisely because both ends of this war still had counterparts of its function. On the Maratha side the Pindari horsemen carried little but spears, and the Maratha infantry included spear-armed foot and javelin men; their firepower mixed matchlocks as the main weapon with flintlock muskets as the secondary one, and their artillery was enormous by numbers, the confederacy being estimated at 589 guns, elephant-mounted and horse-drawn field pieces included, though much of the servicing was in foreign hands - the Peshwa's train reorganised by the Italian Anthony Pohlmann, the battery commanded by Ibrahim Khan Gardi. The British fielded India-pattern flintlock muskets with bayonets, six- and nine-pounder guns, horse artillery and Congreve rocket troops, plus heavy siege pieces used against Sitabuldi, Thalner, Malegaon and Asirgarh. Movement and supply rested on elephants, camels, bullock carts and horses; the British lines ran from Poona through Bombay and onward to Agra and Calcutta, and the army found grain and fodder in superabundance in central India, while the Maratha infantry, largely Bhils, Ramoshis and Arab mercenaries, carried their own ammunition in a bewildering variety of forms and moved their guns and shot far less methodically.
tactics: 馬拉塔一方沿用馬拉塔戰法：以大股輕騎作主要機動，企圖用縱隊迂迴、夜襲與包抄拖散英軍，步兵與火砲混合成散亂的縱隊，騎兵以長矛與標槍近身衝擊；弱點是編制鬆散、指揮不統一，各營缺乏協同，砲隊與步兵之間的配合尤其生硬。英軍打法則是十八世紀末以來成熟的線列縱隊：行軍以縱隊前進，作戰時展開成線齊射，遇騎兵來襲則以帶刺刀的方陣應對——方陣長矛的防騎兵功能，到一八一七年已由刺刀方陣完全接替；火砲以連續火力遮蔽與支援，火箭旅用來騷擾並擾亂對方陣形，龍騎兵與土邦騎兵負責側翼衝鋒。卡德基一役最見高低：英軍步兵縱隊展開後的連續齊射，令馬拉塔縱隊被撕開的缺口無法彌補，四個鐘頭內全線退走，英軍騎兵乘勢追擊。追擊階段英軍以晝夜連續機動、封鎖退路與騎砲火力驅趕，在比馬河畔的科雷岡村落同日反覆爭奪街道與火砲。對平達里的行動以分進合擊、包圍殲滅為主，這批只持長矛的騎兵面對線列步兵完全無法抵抗。圍城戰術上，英軍先以重砲連續轟擊城牆，再以突擊隊攻門，西塔布爾迪與阿西爾伽爾德都是這樣攻落。
tacticsEn: The Marathas fought in the Maratha manner: the mass of light horse was their main instrument of movement, intended to envelop the British by columns, night attacks and turning movements, with infantry and guns mixed into loose formations and the cavalry charging home with spears and javelins. The weakness was loose organisation and divided command, poor coordination between the various corps, and especially clumsy cooperation between guns and foot. The British fought the mature line tactics that had been perfected since the late eighteenth century: columns on the march, deployed lines at the moment of contact, a bayoneted square against cavalry - the anti-cavalry function of the pike square having been taken over completely by the bayonet square by 1817 - field guns masking and supporting, rocket troops harassing and disordering the opposing line, and dragoons and native cavalry delivering the flank charge. The battle of Khadki showed the contrast most clearly: successive volleys from the deployed British infantry denied the Maratha columns any chance of closing the gap that had opened in them, and the whole line was retreating within four hours, with the British cavalry following up the advantage. In the pursuit the British used continuous day-and-night movement, cutting off the retreat and pressing with horse artillery, and at the village of Koregaon on the banks of the Bhima the street and the guns changed hands repeatedly in a single day. The campaign against the Pindaris was one of converging columns and encirclement; spear-armed horsemen simply could not stand against a line of infantry. In siege the British first hammered the walls with heavy guns and then sent in assault parties, and it was in this way that Sitabuldi and Asirgarh were taken.
data: 可核對的數字大致如下，但各史料出入頗大，這裡列出常見說法。時間上，戰爭自一八一七年初浦那方面的危機起，至一八一九年四月九日攻陷阿西爾伽爾德堡為止；其中一八一七年六月十三日《浦那條約》、十一月五日浦那戰鬥與同日《瓜廖爾條約》、十二月二十一日馬希德普爾之戰、一八一八年一月一日科雷岡之戰、一月六日《曼德斯瓦爾條約》、二月七日史密斯入薩塔拉、二月十九日阿斯蒂之戰、四月十日取辛哈加德與普蘭達爾、六月三日佩什瓦投降；一八一八年十一月二十六日西塔布爾迪之戰、同年十二月十九日起圍那伽浦爾、十二月三十日守軍撤出、一八一九年一月九日那伽浦爾條約、四月九日阿西爾伽爾德堡陷落。兵力方面，所引條目記載浦那戰鬥：馬拉塔出動騎兵二萬、步兵八千、火砲二十門，英軍則為騎兵二千、步兵一千、火砲八門；卡德基一役英軍損失八十六人，馬拉塔方面約五百人陣亡。馬希德普爾一役自中午開打到次日清晨三時，英軍損失約八百人，霍爾卡爾軍約三千人死傷，戰場在印多爾以北約四十公里。科雷岡一役英軍投入五百步兵、兩門六磅砲與二百非正規騎兵，其中歐籍步兵僅二十四人，結果英軍損失一百七十五人，過半數歐籍軍官受傷，馬拉塔方面損失五百至六百人。那伽浦爾方面，馬拉塔總兵力約一萬八千，堡內守軍約五千，英軍破牆嘗試損失三百餘人（其中歐籍二十四人），最後以五萬盧比勸降。阿西爾伽爾德守軍約一千二百人，圍城炮擊後於一八一九年四月九日陷落。英方集結約十二萬人、六十餘個本地步兵營，馬拉塔聯盟估算八萬一千步兵、十六萬六千騎兵、五百八十九門火砲，阿米爾汗一萬二千騎、一萬步兵、二百門火砲，平達里首領合計約三萬三千人，其中奇特汗一萬、卡里姆汗六千、瓦西爾·穆罕默德四千。佩什瓦投降後的年俸有兩種記載，一說每年八萬英鎊，一說每年八萬盧比，安置於坎普爾附近的比圖爾。拿薩克鑽石亦在戰利品中被公司沒收。
dataEn: The verifiable figures are roughly as follows, though the sources differ in many places; the usual versions are given here. In time, the war runs from the crisis at Poona in early 1817 to the fall of Asirgarh on 9 April 1819, with the Treaty of Poona on 13 June 1817, the fighting at Poona and the Treaty of Gwalior both on 5 November 1817, the battle of Mahidpur on 21 December 1817, the battle of Koregaon on 1 January 1818, the Treaty of Mandeswar on 6 January 1818, Smith's entry into Satara on 7 February, the fight at Ashti on 19 February, the taking of Sinhagad and Purandar on 10 April and the Peshwa's surrender on 3 June; then the battle of Sitabuldi on 26 November 1818, the siege of Nagpur from 19 December, the garrison's evacuation on 30 December, the Nagpur treaty of 9 January 1819 and the fall of Asirgarh on 9 April. In strength, the account cited gives for the fighting at Poona 20,000 horse, 8,000 foot and 20 guns on the Maratha side against 2,000 horse, 1,000 foot and 8 guns for the British; at Khadki the British lost eighty-six men and the Marathas about five hundred killed. Mahidpur was fought from midday until three in the morning, with British losses of around eight hundred and some three thousand of Holkar's force killed or wounded, forty kilometres north of Indore. At Koregaon the British committed five hundred infantry, two six-pounders and two hundred irregular horsemen, of whom only twenty-four infantry were Europeans, and lost a hundred and seventy-five men with more than half the European officers wounded, against five hundred to six hundred Maratha dead. At Nagpur the Maratha total was about 18,000 with some five thousand shut inside the fort; British attempts to breach the wall cost over three hundred men, of whom twenty-four were Europeans, and the defenders finally took fifty thousand rupees to leave. The garrison of Asirgarh was about 1,200 strong and fell on 9 April 1819 after bombardment. The British assembled some 120,000 men in more than sixty battalions of native infantry; the Maratha confederacy was reckoned at 81,000 foot, 166,000 horse and 589 guns; Amir Khan had 12,000 horse, 10,000 foot and 200 guns; and the Pindari chiefs between them about 33,000, of whom Chitu Khan had 10,000, Karim Khan 6,000 and Wasil Mohammad 4,000. The Peshwa's maintenance after his surrender is given in two versions, about eighty thousand pounds sterling a year and about eighty thousand rupees a year, settled at Bithur near Kanpur. The Nassak Diamond was likewise taken by the Company as a prize of war.
cause: 打起來的原因分遠因與導火線兩層。遠因是《巴森條約》之後的遺留：自一八〇二年起，東印度公司把浦那佩什瓦降為附庸，第二次馬拉塔戰爭雖然打贏，馬拉塔聯盟內部仍保有龐大兵馬與近乎獨立的外交權，本次戰役本質上是英方收拾第二次戰爭的殘局、落實對德干的宗主權。導火線有兩條。一條在浦那：巴吉拉奧二世一八一六年重返王位後坐穩位子，同時暗中重整兵馬，裁而不散佩什瓦騎兵並預支七個月軍餉，招募比爾與拉莫西傭兵，營造要塞，企圖對英方駐在代表埃爾芬斯通下手；一八一七年六月英方使者甘加達爾·沙斯特里遇害，總理津巴克吉·登格萊被懷疑涉案，英方乘機迫簽《浦那條約》，要求割地、放棄對巴羅達的徵稅權、不得與其他勢力往來，並解散佩什瓦騎兵。另一條在北方：平達里傭兵連年劫掠中印度，一八一五年曾有兩萬五千人進入馬德拉斯管轄、摧毀三百餘個村落，英方認定必須剿滅，於是總督黑斯廷斯集結大王軍先取平達里，再圖浦那。戰爭背後還有一層結構性原因：馬拉塔軍隊現代化半途而廢，歐洲傭兵教練的新式營制與舊有馬拉塔戰法並存，砲兵老舊、外籍軍官稀少、間諜與外交體系薄弱、聯邦式權力結構缺乏統一指揮，勝負在開戰之前已經大致定下。
causeEn: The reasons for the fighting fall into a remote cause and two triggers. The remote cause is the legacy of the Treaty of Bassein: from 1802 the East India Company had reduced the Peshwa of Poona to a client, and although the Second Anglo-Maratha War had been won, the Maratha confederacy still kept huge armies and an almost independent foreign policy, so this campaign was in truth the British tidying up of the second war and converting their paramountcy over the Deccan into fact. One trigger lay at Poona: having regained his throne in 1816, Baji Rao II sat firmly in his capital while secretly reorganising his forces, disbanding his cavalry in name only while paying it seven months in advance, hiring Bhils and Ramoshis, fortifying strongholds and planning to remove the British Resident Elphinstone; in June 1817 the British envoy Gangadhar Shastri was murdered, the Peshwa's minister Trimbak Dengle was suspected of the crime, and the British seized the opening to force the Treaty of Poona, demanding territory, the abandonment of claims on Baroda, no communication with other powers and the disbandment of the Peshwa's cavalry. The second trigger lay in the north: the Pindaris had been raiding central India for years, and in 1815 some 25,000 of them entered the Madras Presidency and destroyed more than three hundred villages, so the British resolved to wipe them out, and Governor-General Hastings assembled the Grand Army against the Pindaris first, Poona second. Behind the war lay a structural weakness as well: Maratha modernisation had stalled half-finished, with European-drilled new formations existing side by side with old Maratha methods, obsolete artillery, few foreign officers, a thin intelligence and diplomatic service, and a federal structure of authority with no unified command. The outcome was, in effect, settled before the first shot.
impact: 戰後的影響不只是改變版圖，而是重寫了南亞的權力結構。第一，馬拉塔聯盟作為能對外作戰的軍事集團徹底瓦解：佩什瓦被安置在坎普爾附近的比圖爾，佩什瓦系的土地併入孟買管轄；薩塔拉的普拉塔普·辛格（希瓦吉直系後裔）復國，被英方承認為馬拉塔聯邦的儀式性領袖，但那伽浦爾的拉古吉·邦斯勒三世在未滿十歲時於英方監護下即位，實際領土大部分被沒收。附庸體系同時建立：霍爾卡爾成為受英方常駐代表節制的藩王，辛地亞交出拉賈斯坦，阿富汗人阿米爾汗得到通克並解散火砲，拉賈斯坦諸王公實際上降為接受英國最高權力的封建藩主；平達里活動區被平定之後，日後成為英屬印度中央邦的雛形。第二，這場戰爭也改變了英方的治理與語言政策：埃爾芬斯通整頓地租編制，削弱舊有 patil、deshmukh 與 deshpand 的權力，並自一八二〇年起在孟買管轄推動馬拉塔語的書面化，成為今日馬拉塔語標準的源頭之一。第三，遠期效應延伸到十九世紀：佩什瓦收養的養子納那·薩希卜後來成為一八五七年起義的領袖之一，浦那方面對英方的敵意長期延續；英國自此取得薩特萊吉河以南印度的最高權力，也為一八二四年的第二次英緬戰爭與後來吞併旁遮普創造了前提。第四，在技術層面上，一場戰爭證實線列步兵、刺刀方陣與野砲的組合已能單方面壓制傳統輕騎與矛兵，歐洲傭兵體系隨馬拉塔軍的瓦解而散場，法國在印度的軍事影響自此中斷。
impactEn: What followed was not merely a change of map but a rewriting of the structure of power in South Asia. First, the Maratha confederacy ceased to exist as a military grouping capable of fighting abroad: the Peshwa was settled at Bithur near Kanpur, the Peshwa's lands were absorbed into the Bombay Presidency, Pratap Singh of Satara, a direct descendant of Shivaji, was restored and acknowledged by the British as the ceremonial head of the Maratha confederacy, while Raghuji Bhonsle III of Nagpur, not yet ten years old, was placed on the throne under British guardianship with most of his territory taken away. A system of subsidiary authority was built at the same time: Holkar became a princely state subject to a British Resident, Scindia surrendered Rajasthan, the Afghan Amir Khan received Tonk and disbanded his guns, and the princes of Rajputana were effectively reduced to feudal lords accepting British paramountcy; the country of the Pindaris, once pacified, became the nucleus of the Central Provinces of British India. Second, the war changed British administration and language policy: Elphinstone reorganised the revenue divisions, cut down the authority of the old patil, deshmukh and deshpand, and from 1820 pressed the standardisation of written Marathi in the Bombay Presidency, one of the sources of the modern Marathi literary standard. Third, the long-range consequences ran into the nineteenth century: Nana Sahib, the son adopted by the Peshwa, was later one of the leaders of the rising of 1857, and hostility towards the British in the Poona country long endured; the British now held paramount power over India south of the Sutlej, and the conditions were created for the Second Anglo-Burmese War of 1824 and the later annexation of the Punjab. Fourth, at the technical level a single war had demonstrated that the combination of line infantry, bayoneted squares and field guns could crush traditional light horse and spear-armed foot on its own, and the system of European mercenary officers dissolved with the Maratha armies, ending French military influence in India.
result: 直接結果是英國全面勝利、馬拉塔聯盟解體。一八一七年十一月五日浦那城外出戰，佩什瓦大軍退，浦那隨即陷落，佩什瓦先逃普蘭達爾，再退向薩塔拉方向；英軍由普里茲勒與史密斯接手追擊，一八一八年一月一日在比馬河畔的科雷岡守住村莊與火砲，二月七日入薩塔拉、升英軍旗幟，二月十九日阿斯蒂之戰中巴普·戈卡勒陣亡、薩塔拉王被俘，至四月十日攻下辛哈加德與普蘭達爾，佩什瓦本人則在六月三日投降，被送往坎普爾附近的比圖爾。北方戰線：辛地亞在十一月五日《瓜廖爾條約》割讓拉賈斯坦，霍爾卡爾在十二月二十一日馬希德普爾敗北、次年一月六日簽《曼德斯瓦爾條約》，那伽浦爾在一八一八年十一月底西塔布爾迪失守、十二月三十日撤出、一八一九年一月九日簽約，末了是一八一九年四月九日攻下阿西爾伽爾德堡，全線軍事行動告一段落。平達里首領多數在同年二月之前投降或潰散。放到大格局看，德干與北印度的門戶全部落入英方之手，馬拉塔帝國作為南亞內陸強權的時代結束，英國在印度由邊陲商站變成內陸宗主；這場戰爭也以一件兵器的更替作了註腳：真正決定勝負的已不再是卡面那支長槍，而是刺刀、野砲與制式化的線列。
resultEn: The immediate result was a complete British victory and the dissolution of the Maratha confederacy. On 5 November 1817 the fighting took place outside Poona, the Peshwa's army withdrew and Poona itself fell, the Peshwa first flying to Purandar and then back towards Satara; the pursuit was taken over by Pritzler and Smith, who held the village and the guns at Koregaon on the Bhima on 1 January 1818, entered Satara and raised the British flag on 7 February, and at Ashti on 19 February saw Bapu Gokhale fall defending his master and the Raja of Satara taken prisoner, taking Sinhagad and Purandar by 10 April, while the Peshwa himself surrendered on 3 June and was sent to Bithur near Kanpur. On the northern front, Scindia ceded Rajasthan in the Treaty of Gwalior of 5 November, Holkar was beaten at Mahidpur on 21 December and signed the Treaty of Mandeswar on 6 January the following year, Nagpur lost Sitabuldi at the end of November 1818, evacuated on 30 December and signed a treaty on 9 January 1819, and at last Asirgarh fell on 9 April 1819, bringing all military operations to an end. Most of the Pindari chiefs had surrendered or scattered before the end of February that year. In the larger picture, the approaches to the Deccan and to northern India passed entirely into British hands, the era of the Maratha empire as an inland power in South Asia was over, and the British in India changed from a merchant at the fringe into the sovereign of the interior. The war also carried a postscript in the replacement of one weapon: what decided the outcome was no longer the pike on the card, but the bayonet, the field gun and the standardised line.
